title: Measuring Consistency in Text-based Financial Forecasting Models

bias_targets.methodology: Assessing implicit preferences in Pre-trained Language Models (PLMs) via masked token predictions, specifically comparing the probabilities of generating positive versus negative economic trend words (e.g., 'increased' vs. 'decreased') to detect favoritism towards particular companies or stocks.

Applying meaning-preserving logical transformations (Negation, Symmetric, Additive, and Transitive Consistency) to financial texts to measure performance degradation, evaluating whether models rely on spurious textual artifacts and stereotypes (e.g., exhibiting stereotypes when predicting negative tokens) rather than logical reasoning.
